scope: Original generic Chromium production session switching benchmark; current renderer, serial execution, three repetitions of two tests. This is not a live Microsoft Teams measurement.
method: Median across 15 actual observations for each surface and cold/hot condition. Raw metrics are preserved below. There is no machine-dependent threshold and no causal speedup claim across different hosted jobs.
assessment: All six tests completed with their original assertions. No wrong destination, missing correct destination, or missing/replaced review host was sampled. All six aggregate median timings were lower than the baseline in this pair of hosted runs.
